# Formbricks (`formbricks-formbricks`)

Revolutionize user engagement with Formbricks, the open-source Qualtrics alternative! Create conversion-optimized, privacy-first surveys effortlessly. Empower your team with transformational insights today!

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Formbricks.html) · [Source](https://github.com/formbricks/formbricks)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "formbricks-formbricks"
  name       = "myformbricks"

  parameters = {
    DatabaseUrl        = "..."
    # AwsAccessKeyId     = "..."
    # AwsSecretAccessKey = "..."
    # AwsRegion          = "..."
    # S3BucketName       = "..."
    # S3EndpointUrl      = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DatabaseUrl` | string | yes | Database connection configuration |
| `AwsAccessKeyId` | string | no | Configuration option for awsaccesskeyid |
| `AwsSecretAccessKey` | string | no | Secret key for encryption or authentication |
| `AwsRegion` | string | no | Configuration option for awsregion |
| `S3BucketName` | string | no | Configuration option for s3bucketname |
| `S3EndpointUrl` | string | no | URL endpoint for external service |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
